Anthropic._maxtokens: A CEILING, NOT A CHARGE: the bill is the tokens actually produced, so a headroom that is never reached costs nothing. Too low and the model's answer is cut off mid-JSON, which is billed in full and thrown away. Keep this equal to AnthropicOptions.MaxTokens unless you know why it differs - AppSettingsTests fails if it does not.
Anthropic._prices: SET THESE TO YOUR CONTRACT'S PRICES. USD per million tokens; they are the published list prices for the Model above at the time of writing, and every dollar on the numbers page and the daily ceiling is built on them.

Limits._spend: Round 13 - money: the day's ceiling in ESTIMATED USD (UTC day). 0 is off and the doctor warns about it; 5 is a sane pilot number. At the ceiling every route that would ask the model answers 503 and spends nobody's allowance.

Alerts._where: Round 13 - money. Alerts__Webhook (an https incoming-webhook URL that takes { text }) and Alerts__Email (one address, through the app's own mail) belong in the environment, never here: a webhook URL is a secret. With neither set every alert is only a log line.
